units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:2">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:5:1">VIII, 5</cite> <he>עִילּוּיָהּ מהמדבר</he> her (Israel’s) rise dates from the desert; (Tanḥ. Sh’moth 14 <he>עלייה</he>). Tanḥ.
B’ḥuck. 3 (ref. to ויקח, Gen. II, 15) אין ויקח אלא לשון ע׳ ‘he took’ has the meaning of elevation (with ref. to Gen. XII, 15), v. עָלָה Pi.; a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 2:1:5">Y. Naz. II, 51ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אמר לאדם עִילּוּייוֹ עלי</he> (not <he>עילויין</he>) if one says pointing at a man, I vow his value (instead of <he>ערכו</he>, v. <cite ref="O00580"><he>סִידּוּר</he> I</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 8:7">Arakh. VIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Temurah 7:3">Tem. VII, 3</cite> <he>הקדש ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00789"><he>הֶקְדֵּישׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Temurah 32a:21">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>הקדש ע׳ לבית המקדש</he> consecration of value to be applied to the repair of the Temple. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 4, ch. X <he>אין מוסיפין … על עִילּוּיוֹ של זה</he> we do not demand an addition of one-fifth over this man’s valuation (offer); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 677:1">Yalk.
